title: LIVORA
description:
Want to understand how LIVORA works in more detail?
Use the View the manual link on this store page for a full guide to the game, including Formative Years, Adult Life, Life Pace, relationships, careers, money, health, family, legacy and more.

BUILD A LIFE. LIVE WITH WHAT FOLLOWS.LIVORA is a modern life simulation about building one continuous Life through the choices, opportunities, relationships and consequences that shape it.

Start from birth with Formative Years, where childhood and adolescence help determine the person you become, or begin directly in Adult Life and start building your future straight away.

Build a career. Manage your money. Find somewhere to call home. Form relationships. Raise a family. Look after your health. Study, travel, pursue opportunities, deal with setbacks and decide what actually matters to you.

But you cannot have everything at once.

Your time, money, energy and responsibilities are constantly competing with each other. The decision that improves one part of your Life can put pressure on another.

A better job might transform your finances but leave less time for your relationship. A bigger home could give your family room to grow while stretching your monthly budget. Retraining could open a completely different future — if you can manage what it costs you today.

There is no perfect route.

There is only the Life you build and what follows from it.

LIVE AT YOUR OWN PACE.Not every part of Life needs the same amount of attention.

With Life Pace, you can experience your Life day by day when you want greater detail, or move through quieter periods week by week without simply skipping what happens underneath.

Work continues. Bills are paid. Relationships develop. Health changes. Careers progress. Plans arrive. Consequences unfold.

LIVORA changes how often you need to interact with your Life — not the depth of the simulation behind it.

And when something important happens, your attention comes back to where it matters.

ONE LIFE. EVERYTHING CONNECTED.LIVORA is built as one connected simulation rather than a collection of separate systems.

Your work affects your income, time and stress.

Your finances influence where you can live and which opportunities you can afford to take.

Relationships develop alongside careers, family responsibilities and everyday pressures.

Health can affect what you are able to do.

Education can open doors years later.

Changes in the economy, your neighbourhood and the people around you can create new opportunities or new problems.

You are rarely managing one system at a time.

You are managing a Life.

Across thousands of situations and decisions, your circumstances help shape what happens next.

Some choices have immediate consequences.

Others become part of your history.

Relationships can strengthen, drift or break down. Financial decisions can create security or problems that follow you for years. Opportunities can disappear. Unfinished issues can return.

Something that feels small today might matter much more later.

YOUR WORLD DOESN'T STAND STILL.Your character is not the only person living a Life.

Partners have careers, pressures and ambitions of their own. Children grow up. Family relationships change. Friends can drift away or reconnect. New people can enter your Life through the connections you have already made.

Neighbourhoods evolve. Economic conditions change. Careers move in different directions. Families grow and change shape.

And the things that mattered to you at 20 may feel completely different at 40, 60 or 80.

Alongside the major milestones are the ordinary moments that make a Life feel personal — conversations, bills, interviews, friendships, family plans, hobbies, holidays, difficult weeks, unexpected opportunities and decisions you never expected to face.

Sometimes your plans work.

Sometimes Life has other ideas.

LIVE THROUGH THE YEARS.LIVORA is designed around the long view.

If you begin with Formative Years, the experiences of childhood and adolescence become the foundations of your adult Life rather than being replaced when you turn 18.

From there, careers can develop over decades. Relationships accumulate history. Children become adults. Parents age. Health changes. Money compounds. Homes, communities and priorities evolve.

Your past does not disappear simply because time has moved on.

The Life you lived becomes the Life you continue from.

BUILD MORE THAN A SINGLE LIFE.Eventually, every Life reaches its final chapters.

What remains is not a perfect score telling you whether you succeeded.

It is the history you created — your relationships, family, finances, home, memories, achievements, mistakes and the consequences of the choices you made along the way.

And the story does not necessarily have to end there.

If you leave behind an eligible adult child, you can continue through the next generation and begin another playable Life connected to the family and world that came before it.

The world does not simply reset.

Build a Life. Make it yours. Live with what follows.
description_short: Build one Life in a world that keeps moving. Shape who you become through careers, relationships, family, money, health and thousands of connected choices, where consequences can follow you for years and your story can continue across generations.
